description:
ConsultAdd Inc is inviting applications for PYTHON Developer and RUBY ON RAILS DEVELOPER.
 Job Description For Python:
 

 PYTHON developer responsible for integrating the front-end elements into the application. The Python Developer is responsible for development, testing, and support of software using primarily Python scripting.Python Developers wll do the strong design and development skills to build Python Engine for executing client queries. The ideal candidate will be able to collaboratively design and develop core Python engine for concurrently executing multiple client request for complex (user defined) analytics. He/She will also build Python financial utility library by actively participating in our daily scrums, this candidate will help establish best practices, influence architectural decision and build a performant execution engine. Develop and deliver a behaviorally driven, customized, and compelling eCommerce experience to millions of end users. Support a culture of automation from unit testing to application deployment. Work with product owners to formalize direction.
 

 Job Description for Ruby on Rails:
 

 Build and maintain web applications while prototyping new concepts. Work with team members and user experience team to design consistent, attractive, and user-friendly web interfaces. Focus on front-end development with the ability to work on the back-end web application development if desired. We are looking for a ROR developer responsible for managing the interchange of data between the server and the users. Your primary focus will be development of all server-side logic, definition and maintenance of the central database, and ensuring high performance and responsiveness to requests from the front-end. Rails uses the Model-View-Controller (MVC) architecture pattern, and as the Twitter quote above implies, provides a "scaffolding" which can automatically construct some of the models and views needed for a basic website. Ruby on Rails offers both HTML and XML as output formats, and can be used in Ajax development and in building Restful web services.
 


 

 ELIGIBILITY
 - A four year Bachelor's degree, or a higher level degree (such as Masters) from an accredited University or college
 -Minimum hands-on IT work experience of up to 3 years in a highly technical and fast paced
 

 Company Description :­ ConsultAdd is leading provider of Information Technology, Consulting and Business process services. Our dedication employees offer strategic insights, technological expertise and industry experience .Work supported by a global delivery network that helps large organisation responds to challenges of future of work with flexible and efficient operations.
